```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 3.5)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(pkgload::load_all("..", quiet = TRUE, export_all = TRUE))
library(ggplot2)
result <- analyse(params$data, load_contract())
m <- result$metrics
f <- result$features
pct <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f %%", 100 * x)
```

## 1. The question

Every month the retention team can call **10 %** of active subscribers with an offer. ChurnCast ranks them by the
probability that they will not pay next month. Export **`r m$dataset$export`**, contract
**`r m$dataset$contract_version`**.

## 2. Data quality: what cleaning changed

```{r issues}
knitr::kable(data.frame(issue = names(m$data_quality$issues), rows = unlist(m$data_quality$issues)), row.names = FALSE)
```

## 3. Churn per snapshot (train = grey, out-of-time test = red)

```{r snapshots}
s <- do.call(rbind, lapply(m$snapshots, as.data.frame))
ggplot(s, aes(snapshot, churn_rate, fill = split)) + geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(train = "#9aa5b1", test = "#d64545")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + labs(x = NULL, y = "churn next month")
```

Train rows **`r m$split$train_rows`** (churn `r pct(m$split$train_churn_rate)`), test rows **`r m$split$test_rows`**
(churn `r pct(m$split$test_churn_rate)`). Customers in two folds: **`r m$split$customers_in_two_folds`**.

## 4. Experiments: grouped 5-fold cross-validation, then the test months once

```{r experiments}
e <- do.call(rbind, lapply(m$experiments, function(x) data.frame(
  id = x$id, name = x$name, cv_auc = round(x$cv$auc_mean, 4), cv_sd = round(x$cv$auc_sd, 4),
  test_auc = round(x$test$auc, 4), test_brier = round(x$test$brier, 4),
  precision_top10 = round(x$test$precision_at_top, 3), net_inr_month = round(x$test$net_value_inr_per_month)
)))
knitr::kable(e, row.names = FALSE)
```

Champion: **`r m$champion$experiment`**: `r m$champion$reason`.

## 5. What drives the score (standardised coefficients)

```{r importance}
imp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(m$champion$importance, as.data.frame))
imp$feature <- factor(imp$feature, levels = rev(imp$feature))
ggplot(imp, aes(standardised, feature)) + geom_col(fill = "#3b6ea8") + labs(x = "log-odds per SD", y = NULL)
```

## 6. Calibration on the test months

```{r calibration, fig.width = 4.5, fig.height = 4.5}
b <- do.call(rbind, lapply(Filter(function(x) x$n > 0, m$calibration$bins), as.data.frame))
ggplot(b, aes(mean_pred, observed)) + geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", colour = "#9aa5b1") +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), colour = "#d64545") + coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 0.6), ylim = c(0, 0.6)) +
  labs(x = "mean predicted", y = "observed churn")
```

ECE **`r round(m$calibration$ece, 4)`** (gate: at most `r load_contract()$gate$max_ece`).

## 7. Slices and fairness

```{r slices}
for (dim in names(m$slices)) {
  rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(m$slices[[dim]], function(r) {
    data.frame(value = r$value, n = r$n, churn_rate = round(r$churn_rate, 3), mean_pred = round(r$mean_pred, 3),
               auc = if (is.null(r$auc)) NA else round(r$auc, 3), recall_top10 = round(r$recall_at_top, 3))
  }))
  print(knitr::kable(rows, caption = dim, row.names = FALSE))
}
```

Recall gap across age bands: **`r round(m$fairness$recall_gap, 3)`** (max `r m$fairness$max_recall_gap`).

## 8. The gate

```{r gate}
knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, lapply(m$gate$checks, as.data.frame)), digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
```

Gate: **`r if (m$gate$passed) "PASSED" else "FAILED"`**.
